text:
amir: dropping quick notes after today's design pass on Autoscale controls. main concerns: how we present guardrail severity, burst pill semantics for sparse pools, and short-copy for localized languages. figma: https://figma.redwood/infer/autoscale/compact

riley: For sparse pools (<=3 gpus) absolute numbers feel noisy — showing +1 GPU can look like 33% which scares folks. propose: show absolute on hover, percent inline when pool size <=3? or the opposite?

patti: prefer absolute for small pools, but display contextual tooltip: 'this is ~33% of your pool' so users get both. also, shorter sentences for translation teams help. l10n-bot: note.

ben: Guardrail label: two choices we tried: 'Recommended cap' vs 'Safety cap'. My take: 'Recommended cap' for self-serve; 'Safety cap' could be used in enterprise docs where admins want stronger language. Also add a subtle chevron tooltip: 'why recommended?'

amir: Good. UX: add a tiny info icon next to guardrail that opens a 2-line explain: 'Keeps most traffic within latency SLO; excess may go to fallback capacity.' Avoid 'throttle'.

riley: Accessibility: current orange-on-white passes color contrast at 16px but fails at 12px when used in helper text. Suggest darker orange (#8B4500) and 3px focus ring for keyboard. Also ensure aria-live updates when guardrail changes.

patti: Copy tweak for l10n: use simpler verbs. Eg replace 'routed to lower-priority capacity' with 'sent to fallback capacity'. Shorter and easier to translate. l10n-bot: flagged.

ben: Burst pill: small state idea — line1 bold: '+1 GPU' line2 muted: '(~+33%)' — collapse to single line on mobile. On very large pools (>24) show percent only.
amir: Sounds good. Also add analytic events: burst_pill_click, guardrail_info_opened, pool_picker_keyboard_hint_shown.

riley: Keyboard: pool picker currently traps due to virtualization. Implement roving tabindex plus `aria-activedescendant` on the listbox so screen readers announce focused item and Escape/Tab close. Add hint: 'Use arrows to preview, Enter select, Esc close' under the control.

patti: l10n note: keep hints under 40 chars where possible. 'Arrows to preview • Enter select • Esc close' fits.

ben: I'll update the figma and add a compact mobile variant that hides the second line of burst pill. Amir, can you create tickets for analytics + a11y?
amir: Yep INF-3344 (analytics) INF-3345 (a11y). I'll upload updated frames tonight and ping eng. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
